lines.text: I'm kind of in the middle
of something here, yes, thank you.
I've come a long way for you, Franck.
But you are so much more
than just a sheep, aren't you?
Look at you. You're an adventurer, Franck.
One doesn't even choose to be a wolf.
I don't know what you're on about,
And I suggest you do the same.
No, no, no, no, Franck, wait, wait, wait.
Yeah, just give me one minute.
You would have one more minute,
Ah, you will not regret this.
all the lives you ever wanted,
It took me ages to tie that rope
Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait.
I mean, how do I make it work?
I just turned it on for you.
We will pick you up. Don't worry.
It took me ages to tie
how do I make it work?

meta.context: Cosmos Laundromat: First Cycle (2015), a Blender Institute animated short film: on a desolate island, Franck, a suicidal sheep, meets Victor, a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime.
